title: DORM: Preference Data Weights Optimization for Reward Modeling in LLM Alignment
authors_zh: Rongzhi Zhang, Chenwei Zhang, Xinyang Zhang, Liang Qiu, Haoming Jiang, Yuchen Zhuang, Qingru Zhang, Hyokun Yun, Xian Li, Bing Yin, Tuo Zhao, Chao Zhang
paper_type_zh: 用于奖励模型的偏好数据重加权研究
best_for_zh: 适合混合多种偏好来源，并希望在奖励模型或偏好学习训练前以原则化方法替代硬筛选的读者。
one_line: DORM learns validation-regularized weights for heterogeneous preference data so reward-model training emphasizes informative uncertainty and downweights likely noise.
DORM 为异构偏好数据学习由验证集正则化的权重，使奖励模型训练强调有信息量的不确定样本并降低可能噪声的影响。
why: It makes data importance a learned training object and carries that decision through reward modeling to downstream policy alignment.
inclusion_reason: It changes which preference records train a reward model by learning their validation-grounded weights instead of treating all labels as equally useful.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference collections combine labels of unequal reliability and learning value. Hard filtering can discard difficult but informative examples, while treating every remaining record equally lets noisy labels distort a reward model. Existing heuristics also do not adapt when the reward model has learned some data sources better than others.

DORM asks how preference records should contribute to reward-model training rather than whether they should be categorically retained. It learns an importance weight for each source under a validation objective: uncertain yet label-consistent examples should receive more influence, whereas examples whose labels strongly conflict with model predictions should be downweighted.

偏好集合混合了可靠性和学习价值并不相同的标签。硬筛选可能丢弃困难但有信息量的例子，而把每条保留记录一视同仁又会让噪声标签扭曲奖励模型。既有启发式方法也不会随着奖励模型对不同数据源的学习程度变化而调整。

DORM 要回答的是，偏好记录应当如何贡献于奖励模型训练，而不是是否应被绝对保留。它在验证集目标下学习每个来源的重要性权重：不确定但与标签一致的例子应获得更多影响，而标签与模型预测强烈冲突的例子应被降低权重。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DORM distinguishes informative uncertainty from likely annotation noise. Monte Carlo dropout estimates whether a reward model is uncertain about a record; disagreement measures the gap between the expected prediction and the provided label. Its prior weight grows with uncertainty but shrinks with disagreement, so a hard reliable example is not treated like a suspicious label.

The prior is only a starting point. A bilevel procedure learns weights that improve a high-quality validation set while regularizing them toward those quality estimates. Data importance is therefore a dynamic training variable, and the reward model consumes a weighted mixture rather than a fixed curated subset.

DORM 将有信息量的不确定性与可能的标注噪声区分开来。蒙特卡洛 dropout 估计奖励模型对一条记录是否不确定；分歧度量预期预测与给定标签之间的差距。其先验权重会随不确定性增长，却会随分歧缩小，因此一个困难但可靠的例子不会被当作可疑标签处理。

该先验只是起点。一个双层过程学习能改善高质量验证集的权重，同时将它们正则化到这些质量估计附近。因此，数据重要性成为动态训练变量，奖励模型消费的是加权混合，而不是一个固定整理后的子集。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper computes a prior weight exp(u minus gamma times q), where u is prediction variance across dropout passes and q is normalized label disagreement. It trains a Mistral NeMo 12B reward model with a 12-attribute regression head over HelpSteer2, OpenAssistant2, Magpie-Qwen-2.5, OffsetBias, and WildGuard after normalizing their rating scales.

At the lower level, the weighted records train the reward model. At the upper level, validation loss adjusts their weights, with an L2 term keeping them near the uncertainty-disagreement prior; a first-order hypergradient avoids second-order Hessians. The resulting reward model labels an UltraFeedback DPO set for a Mistral-7B policy after one SFT epoch.

论文计算先验权重 exp(u 减 gamma 乘 q)，其中 u 是多次 dropout 前向传播中的预测方差，q 是归一化的标签分歧。它在统一评分尺度后，使用带有 12 属性回归头的 Mistral NeMo 12B 奖励模型，处理 HelpSteer2、OpenAssistant2、Magpie-Qwen-2.5、OffsetBias 和 WildGuard。

在下层，加权记录训练奖励模型。在上层，验证损失调整其权重，而 L2 项使权重保持在不确定性—分歧先验附近；一阶超梯度避免了二阶 Hessian。得到的奖励模型会为 UltraFeedback 的 DPO 集合标注，以便在一轮监督微调后训练 Mistral-7B 策略。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With 50K training records, the reported 12B DORM reward model reaches 90.5 overall on RewardBench. The paper compares this with 90.4 for ArmoRM trained on 585.4K records and 90.2 for InternLM2-20B-reward trained on 2.4 million records. Its component study reports an average of 90.2 for the combined method, above 85.3 for unweighted SFT, 86.4 for prior weighting only, and 89.1 for bilevel optimization without the prior.

For a downstream test, the authors use the trained reward model to label UltraFeedback and align a Mistral-7B policy. They report a 61.2% win rate, above the listed ablations and public reward-model baselines. The evidence supports data efficiency, but it comes from the authors' mixture, a 5K validation regime, and an independent reward model used as the policy evaluator.

使用 5 万条训练记录时，报告的 12B DORM 奖励模型在 RewardBench 上达到 90.5 的总分。论文将其与使用 58.54 万条记录训练而得 90.4 的 ArmoRM，以及使用 240 万条记录训练而得 90.2 的 InternLM2-20B-reward 比较。其组件研究报告组合方法平均为 90.2，高于未加权监督微调的 85.3、仅先验加权的 86.4，以及没有先验的双层优化的 89.1。

在下游测试中，作者使用训练好的奖励模型为 UltraFeedback 标注，并对齐一个 Mistral-7B 策略。他们报告 61.2% 的胜率，高于所列消融和公开奖励模型基线。证据支持数据效率，但它来自作者的数据混合、5K 验证设置，以及一个被用作策略评估器的独立奖励模型。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not ordinary reward-model training with another loss. DORM makes the training record's weight a learned object tied to two distinct claims: uncertainty can signal learning opportunity, while prediction-label conflict can signal unreliability. The same record can therefore become more or less influential as the reward model and validation objective evolve.

Unlike top-score filtering, this preserves a continuous path from a source record to its training influence. Unlike a fixed data mixture, it makes validation performance decide which preference sources matter. That change reaches downstream alignment because the resulting reward model is later used to create or score the preference supervision consumed by a policy.

其贡献并不是使用另一种损失进行普通奖励模型训练。DORM 使训练记录的权重成为一个学习对象，并将其连接到两种不同主张：不确定性可以表明学习机会，而预测—标签冲突可以表明不可靠性。因此，随着奖励模型和验证目标的发展，同一条记录可以变得更有或更少影响力。

与最高分筛选不同，这保留了从来源记录到其训练影响的连续路径。与固定数据混合不同，它让验证性能决定哪些偏好来源重要。这一改变会延伸到下游对齐，因为得到的奖励模型随后被用来创建或评分策略所消费的偏好监督。

title: Limitations
局限
html: For efficiency, the current implementation assigns dataset-level rather than record-level weights, so within-source quality variation is not fully modeled. It depends on a high-quality validation set; systematic validation noise can steer the learned mixture in the wrong direction. Bilevel training is also substantially heavier than ordinary SFT, with the reported three-epoch run using 16 A100-80G GPUs. The paper declares no official implementation, model, or released weighted dataset, and the licenses and provenance of all upstream sources require separate review.
为提高效率，当前实现分配的是数据集级而非记录级权重，因此同一来源内部的质量变化没有被完全建模。它依赖高质量验证集；系统性的验证噪声可能把学习到的混合引向错误方向。双层训练也比普通监督微调重得多，报告的三轮训练使用了 16 张 A100-80G GPU。论文没有声明官方实现、模型或发布的加权数据集，所有上游来源的许可证和出处仍需单独审查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: DORM is essential for teams choosing among heterogeneous preference sources, especially when labels cannot safely be removed by a single heuristic. It gives a concrete way to document uncertainty, disagreement, a weight prior, validation signal, and the eventual training consumer. Its practical cost means it is better treated as an ablation-backed recipe than a default: first validate the source mixture and held-out set, then compare record-level, source-level, and simple filtering alternatives under the available compute budget.
DORM 对于需要在异构偏好来源之间做选择的团队是必读，尤其当标签不能安全地通过单个启发式删除时。它给出记录不确定性、分歧、权重先验、验证信号和最终训练消费者的具体方式。其实际成本意味着应把它视为有消融支持的方案而非默认做法：先验证来源混合和留出集，再在可用计算预算下比较记录级、来源级和简单筛选替代方案。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3 and 4 together: Section 3 defines the prior and bilevel objective, while Section 4 shows which five sources, validation sizes, backbone, and downstream consumer were actually used. Table 2 is important because it separates the contribution of the quality prior from the bilevel update. The reported text sometimes describes sample weights while the limitation specifies dataset-level assignment; preserve that distinction when reproducing or summarizing the method. No official artifact is linked, so any implementation must be checked against the paper's equations and hyperparameters rather than inferred from a repository.
应将第 3 节和第 4 节结合阅读：第 3 节定义先验和双层目标，第 4 节展示实际使用的五个来源、验证集大小、基础模型和下游消费者。表 2 很重要，因为它区分了质量先验和双层更新各自的贡献。报告文本有时描述样本权重，而局限明确说明采用数据集级分配；复现或概述方法时应保留这一差异。没有链接官方制品，因此任何实现都必须对照论文方程和超参数核验，而不能从仓库推断。
